comment: Two of the 48 parameters have no widget and so get no line: EUCLID_PARAM (44), whose addParam line is commented out at src/XLimitJIAutotuner2.cpp:1125 although it is still configured with the names Root only, Input order, Ascending harminic order and Descending harmonic order for a range of 0 to 4, which is one name short; and NONE_PARAM (47), which nothing reads. S0_PARAM is named Subarmonic where the other seven are named Subharmonic, so that row's second knob shows a different tooltip from its neighbours. The panel prints the columns as a-n, b-n, s-n, x-min and x-max, which the maker's parameter names give as Harmonic, Subharmonic, Shift, Lower Bound and Upper Bound. The module has no context menu of its own. Index order and panel order agree, column by column, except that the Shift column sits between the ratio pair and the bounds on the panel while its indices (32 to 39) come after all of them.
